research_reports.title: TrackTemplate: independent railway engineering reference bibliography
research_reports.inspection_attribution: All research_observations attributed to this report preserve its researcher’s claims. Registration did not repeat drawing inspection, retrieve drawing bytes or verify current remote access. Drawing examined in the report means visual inspection, not complete dimensional transcription or acceptance.
research_findings: The report identifies remotely available dimensioned S.I., rail, key, switch and crossing drawings in LMS-SRE-1928. Catalogue-only archive access is not a prerequisite for their later assessment.
LMS No.18, No.18A and No.38 retain their stated relationships and supersession within one drawing family, not as independent corroboration.
Identical labels do not establish identical patterns. LMS No.4, the unnumbered NRM S.I. entry and the unseen NERA sheet are not one verified revision. The company examples remain distinct.
Printed dimensions take priority over uncalibrated scan measurements. Full-size labels, worn examples and retrospective explanations do not automatically establish original dimensions.
The handover states that its bibliography contains no Templot-derived dimensions or modelling algorithms. This claim does not reclassify existing Templot lineage or accepted data.
The individual S.I. revision history and the NRM drawing remain unresolved. Wooden-key references are present; no dimensioned spring-steel-key drawing was verified in the reported pass.

Prototype geometry, model adaptations and manufacturing compensation remain separate. Model rail, gauge/flangeway choices, simplifications and process allowances are not dimensions supplied by these prototype drawings.
registration_boundaries: The remote LMS drawing priorities are leads for later assessment. No drawing transcription, dimension adoption, geometry implementation or evidence admission occurs here.

NRM archival references, NERA purchase or contact, BSI access and PWI consultation remain optional. No physical visit, purchase, archive request or external message is required or authorised by this registration.
The report states that it made no purchases, archive requests or external messages and changed no repository files. No source scans accompany it or are redistributed by this registration.
Provider licensing statements remain attributed claims. No legal chain, production clearance or third-party redistribution permission is accepted.
All pre-existing candidate-source fields and all 113 quantity records remain unchanged. Numerical callouts are research observations, not canonical dimensions or accepted tolerances.
Phase 9A acceptance and Phase 9B production boundaries remain unchanged.
